state.message: I must inform you that my order, number 77452, placed on the fourth of this month, has still not arrived despite the delivery date passing eight days ago, and I would greatly appreciate it if a representative could finally look into this matter, as my previous three inquiries have gone unanswered.

Good afternoon. I telephoned your office three times this past week regarding my overdue denture adjustment and have yet to receive a reply, which I must say I find rather disappointing. I would be grateful if someone could attend to this matter promptly.

I have been a customer since 2019, recommended this tool to three companies, and trained forty people on it — and last Friday the migration your team ran silently deleted my archived project history going back to 2020, which contains legal records I am now obligated to produce in an audit. Your agent told me deleted data is 'usually unrecoverable' and then closed the ticket as resolved without telling me. Reopen it, escalate it, and have someone with authority contact me today, because if this data is gone I am done and my lawyer will have questions.

After 11 years of loyal attendance, two kids raised in this practice, a mortgage worth of cleanings and fillings paid on time, my family got dropped as patients over one voicemail that their own receptionist claims was 'rude' — which is hilarious coming from a front desk that has kept us waiting an hour more times than I can count — and I want everyone reading this to know exactly what kind of people run this place.

I must say I am rather disappointed with my experience this evening. The app failed to apply my promotional discount of £7.50 despite my entering the code correctly on two occasions, and the customer service assistant informed me the promotion had 'expired yesterday,' which it had not, as the terms state it runs through the end of the week. I have been a regular customer for some years and would appreciate this small matter being put right. It is not the money so much as the principle of being told one is mistaken.

My smart lock unresponsive for 12 hours. Locked us out of our own house.

Paid £300 for this. Support line closed. Zero help. Unacceptable.

Hi, this is Marcus. I've been a customer for over 4 years, order basically every weekend. Last Friday I ordered from_nonna's pizza for my daughter's birthday dinner, waited almost 2 hours and the app kept saying 'arriving soon' the whole time. Food showed up cold and the driver never even apologized

I've been trying to get in touch since Friday and nobody responds. I'm not asking for anything crazy, just a refund for order 73456B ($42.10) but this is really disappointing for a birthday. Please get back to me, thanks

DO NOT order from RxQuickShip. Order #RX-884312 placed March 2 for my father's heart medication — charged $214.68, 'delivered' on March 9 per their tracking, but nothing ever arrived. Today is March 20. I've called 6 times, and yesterday an agent told me the package was 'probably lost' and I'd need to file a claim and wait 30 business days for a refund. My father missed two doses already. Worst pharmacy experience of my life, and I will be disputing the charge and reporting this company everywhere I can.

Congratulations on achieving something truly remarkable: an online pharmacy that managed to charge my card, lose my prescription, and hang up on me twice — all before lunch. I especially enjoyed the automated email assuring me my order was 'on its way' while the tracking page cheerfully declared it nonexistent. That kind of consistency takes real dedication. I have now spent three weeks and six phone calls trying to obtain medication that costs eleven dollars at the pharmacy down the street. Each call, I am promised an 'escalation,' a word I can only assume means the matter is thrown into a volcano. My doctor's office has faxed the prescription twice at your request, and I am told both times it 'never arrived.' Fascinating, given that fax machines have managed to reach every other pharmacy in the state since roughly 1992. Rest assured, I will be sharing this entire experience — screenshots, call logs, and all — with my insurance company, the state licensing board, and every review platform that will have me. Do not bother sending a template apology. Send my refund.

I am writing to request a correction to my account, as my April 12 invoice lists a fluoride treatment that I declined during my visit, and I would appreciate an updated statement reflecting only the services actually provided.

Absolutely dismal. My installation appointment #S-77431, scheduled for June 8th between 8am and 12pm, was cancelled by the technician at 11:47am with no rescheduling offered. I took a half day of unpaid leave for it. Since then I've called support four times, been billed the full $74.99 on June 15th for a service that was never installed, and my cancellation request submitted June 9th has generated nothing but an automated reply.

Two weeks later I still have no internet, an open charge of $74.99, and a billing dispute case (#D-20981) that nobody has touched. Save yourself the trouble and sign up with anyone else.

I have used your company's application several times this year without difficulty. However, I was unable to retrieve my online account for roughly two weeks, which required me to book by telephone instead. I trust the matter will be sorted out in due course; the telephone staff were very helpful.

Order #77109, placed February 2nd. Card charged twice, $94.80 each time — one charge reversed, the other still pending 23 days later. Four support tickets submitted (refs 33218, 33455, 34002, 34177), each closed with no reply. Two promised callback windows missed. Item never shipped and is now listed as out of stock. I expect the duplicate charge refunded, the order honored or fully refunded, and a written explanation — today.

Good afternoon. I am writing to inquire about my monthly invoice, which appears to be somewhat higher than usual this cycle. I would be most grateful if a representative could kindly review the charges and explain any difference. I have been a customer for over eleven years and have always found your service satisfactory. Thank you for your time and assistance. Kind regards, Margaret Ellison, account holder since 2014.

I am writing regarding my appointment on April 12, which was cancelled by your office the evening before. This is the second such cancellation this quarter, and both times the rescheduled date is several weeks out. I would like to know what steps are being taken to prevent this from recurring.

Downgrading my rating again until this is fixed: notifications arrive hours late, the calendar view drops recurring tasks randomly, and my timesheet entries vanish after sync. I have kept logs of every occurrence this month. Paying for the pro tier while doing the QA myself is not the deal I signed up for.

What a wonderful week it's been. My $1,300 sectional arrived with a three-inch tear in the chaise on July 2nd — ticket #55903, photos attached the same day. I then spent a delightful 40 minutes on hold, got disconnected, called back, and was told a replacement would ship 'in 5-7 business days.' That was eighteen business days ago, and today the courier tried to deliver a single cushion, apparently the entire replacement order. Meanwhile your support chat closed my ticket as 'resolved' without asking me a single question. Truly impressive work. I'd like a real human to contact me by Friday with an actual solution, not another form letter.

I've been using this app since September 2023 and mostly it works fine, but I wanted to note a few things. My order #30519 from 14 February was delayed by five days with no notification until I contacted support. Also, on 2 March I was quoted $24.99 at checkout but charged $31.20 for order #31002 — the extra charge was for a 'processing fee' I hadn't seen disclosed anywhere. Support did resolve both issues when I reached out, and the refund for the fee arrived in four days.

Overall the medication selection and delivery are reliable when things go normally, and the pharmacist chat feature is genuinely useful. I'd just like to see better proactive notifications for delays and clearer fee disclosures at checkout. Three stars for now, but fixable.

Customer called to ask about a delay. He explained that he retired last year and moved his savings into crypto to learn something new, and that his daughter set up the account for him back in the spring. He placed his first sell order last week and noticed the payout has not arrived in his checking account yet. He wanted to confirm everything was fine on the exchange's side.

The agent confirmed the payout is processing normally and should land within two business days. Customer said that was good to hear, thanked the agent, and mentioned he would wait a couple more days before worrying about it. No escalation needed.

acct 55201. 6 calls since jan 2. 4 hours on hold total.
- promised callback on the 9th: never happened
- promised credit on the 14th: never applied
- connection dropped again this morning, day 12 straight
if nobody calls me back by friday i am closing the account and disputing every charge since december.

Dear Support Team, I just wanted to congratulate you on the truly impressive achievement of scheduling a technician visit three times and failing to show up on each occasion — quite a streak. The last appointment was on Tuesday, March 12th, between 8 AM and 12 PM, a generous four-hour window that I dutifully sat through while working from my phone hotspot. Perhaps the technician is simply very busy, or perhaps nobody was ever coming. Either way, I would appreciate an actual human response this time, preferably before I finish paying for a service I am not receiving. Regards, D. Kowalski

Updating my review since the app still has the same problems:
- Checkout randomly resets my saved address to an old one (ordered a dresser to my previous apartment, thanks)
- The search filter for 'in stock' doesn't work, shows items that aren't available in any store
- Push notifications arrive days after the event they're notifying me about
The furniture itself is fine, but the app makes shopping here way more annoying than it should be. Please fix.

I regret to say this app has caused me the worst customer service experience of my life. I purchased tickets for a show on 2 June, the payment went through twice, and despite contacting support four times over two weeks, I have received nothing but automated replies. I am still out nearly $400.

I say this politely but firmly: do not trust this platform with your money. Refunds that were promised in writing have never arrived, and phone lines disconnect after an hour on hold. This is completely unacceptable treatment of paying customers, and I strongly urge the developers to fix their billing system and support process immediately.

Third time this month: order #75120 placed March 14th at 6:42pm for $34.87, driver canceled after 40 minutes, refund 'initiated' March 14th still not posted March 21st, and today order #75366 for $18.40 went to literally the wrong address across town — how is this app this broken, I'm done chasing support for money I'm owed.

So a bit of a backstory: we adopted our senior cat Clementine after she spent six years in a hoarding situation, and she only eats one specific renal diet food, which I can only reliably get from this shop. Last week I got an email saying my autoship order #66408 had shipped, and then a vet visit revealed Clementine needs surgery on a benign tumor, so I really needed that food timeline to be predictable because budgeting is tight right now.

Anyway, the long and short of it is the tracking showed 'out for delivery' for two days straight before it finally arrived, and the box was left in the rain even though I had delivery notes asking for the porch. The food bags were damp on one corner but the inner lining seems fine, so Clementine's stash survived. Just a gentle nudge to whoever handles the delivery instructions — please read the notes.
I would like to report that the status page continues to show all systems operational even though my dashboard clearly indicates degraded performance in the eu-west zone.
hey my verification selfie got rejected twice this week for no clear reason, kind of annoying since the pic is fine, can someone actually tell me whats wrong

caller reports his data plan keeps getting throttled way before the cap hits. says he's checked usage in the app and he's only used like 6 gigs of his 20. been going on two months now.
agent reset the network settings but caller says he already tried that twice himself. agent offered a $5 credit, caller sighed and said fine whatever just make it work. caller not angry just tired of repeating the same fix every month.

Ah yes, the entire campus VPN has been unreachable for three days and my thesis data sits on a server I can no longer reach. But I'm sure the auto-email telling me to 'try clearing my cache' is doing important work somewhere. Anyway, has anyone actually gotten through to a human on this, or should I just plan around it?

Caller is extremely irate about an account suspension she says is completely baseless. Key points: • She was locked out 11 days ago with no explanation • She submitted her ID twice and got no response • She needs the app for her commute to work and has missed shifts • Two support chats were closed without resolution.

She states she has been a loyal customer for four years and finds this treatment unacceptable. She demands the account be reinstated today, a written apology, and compensation for the rides she had to book elsewhere. She says if this is not resolved she will take her business to a competitor and tell everyone about it.

Good afternoon. This is Harold Jenkins, account 77032. I telephoned your office on the 3rd of May and was assured a technician would attend my residence on Friday. No one arrived, and I have received no further communication.

I must now request, once again, that this matter be given your immediate attention. I am 74 years of age and have been without a reliable connection for eleven days, which prevents me from contacting my doctor by video as instructed. I expect a confirmed appointment this week.

Hi, this is Priya. My ride #59201 tonight took 25 extra minutes to arrive and I was charged a wait fee of $4.50 even though the driver texted that he was stuck in traffic. Please refund the wait fee, thanks.

I am writing regarding invoice #4471-993 from last month. To summarise my concerns: (1) I was charged twice for the same international roaming package; (2) my first three support calls each lasted over 40 minutes without resolution; (3) the promised callback on 14 March never came; (4) the duplicate charge remains on my statement as of today. I have attached screenshots of both charges. I would appreciate a corrected invoice and confirmation in writing within five business days, as I had expected this to be a straightforward matter to resolve.

Caller, an older gentleman named Walter, explained at length that he has been a loyal customer since the store was a single showroom in his hometown, that he bought his first dining set there in 1987 when his late wife was still alive, and that he chose the same brand again for his daughter's new house as a kind of family tradition. He then described how the $3,400 table he ordered in April arrived shattered in March, how the replacement has been "in the warehouse" for eleven weeks, and how the last agent hung up on him mid-sentence. Caller was shouting for most of the conversation, repeatedly demanded a full refund and a written apology, stated he was reporting the company to consumer protection, and ended the call by saying he would make sure everyone in his church group and his entire retirement community heard about this.

Hello, I ordered my vitamins on 3rd of this month and tracking says delivered on 5th, but package is not at my door. This is second time happening. Can you please send again or refund? I am getting a bit tired of this.

Hi, I'd like someone to actually look at ticket #77219 instead of sending me the same copy-paste reply. My delivery address was changed in the app without my knowledge, so my groceries on March 2 went to a stranger across town, and the photo 'confirmation' uploaded was of someone else's porch. I've now spent four days and six messages trying to get this corrected. A goodwill credit doesn't fix the fact that my address book apparently edits itself.

The brakes on the Hyundai I rented (plate 7XJ204) were grinding badly on the highway Thursday. I had to pull over and call your roadside line, nobody came for over two hours.

I still don't have confirmation that car was taken off the road. Please respond.

Been using this app for about two years now, mostly fine, but the last update seems to have broken the saved payment method feature. I have to re-enter my card every single time now, which is a small thing but adds up when you shop a lot like I do. Also my wishlist items randomly disappear and then reappear a day later, which I guess is kind of funny but mostly just annoying. Three stars because the selection is still good, but please fix the checkout flow.

So let me tell you how my night went. Bought presale tickets back in January for my daughter's birthday, her first real concert, she's been counting down for months. Day of the show, the app refuses to load the tickets, just spins and spins. Missed the entire opening act standing in the venue lobby refreshing my phone while a staff member shrugged and said the barcode servers 'go down sometimes.' Finally got in halfway through the third song, daughter in tears, birthday ruined. Then this morning the site had the nerve to email me asking how my experience was. Oh, and the seat photos on their listing? Taken at an angle that conveniently hides the support pillar blocking half the stage. We spent eleven months looking forward to this.

I was charged $347.89 twice on reservation #A-88213 for the rental of March 3rd–6th, and after five calls and three emails over twelve days I have received nothing but automated replies, so I demand an immediate full refund and confirmation in writing today.

Five stars for creativity — I've never seen an app that can lose an order, double-charge a card, AND log me out in the same session. Truly a triple crown. The chat button leads to a loading spinner that has apparently been spinning since Tuesday, and the FAQ helpfully suggests I "check my order status," which I would love to do if my order status existed.

The best part is the automated email promising a response "within 24 hours," which arrived four days ago and has been followed by nothing. I've now disputed the charge with my bank, which took less time than getting this app to load my order history. If I could give zero stars I would, but apparently the app can't handle that either.

Well, what a surprise — the Q3 reconciliation report exported as a blank PDF for the fourth time this week. I've come to look forward to my morning ritual of clicking 'Export' and receiving a lovely empty page. Perhaps at some point the numbers might actually join the party? No rush, of course. I've attached screenshots in case you'd like to admire the whitespace too.

Hello, I am writing about my current account. On Monday my salary was deposited but your system charged me a monthly fee that should be waived for my plan. I already spoke with a chat agent last week who promised the fee would be returned within 3 working days, but nothing has happened and it is still not refunded. Please can somebody actually fix this, it is starting to become annoying that I keep having to ask again.

Caller, speaking English as a second language, asked for help understanding the verification process. He said his ID upload from Tuesday is still showing pending and he is not sure if he did the selfie step correct. He was patient and thanked the agent, only requesting to know how many days the review usually takes.

I am writing because since 6 days my account show balance zero and all my 2024 transactions are disappeared. This is not acceptable, my company needs this records for tax office and deadline is Friday. I open three tickets (last one #77109-T) and nobody answer me nothing, only automatic email. If you not restore my data this week I will report your company and cancel my $89 monthly plan, I am client since 3 years and this is how you treat loyal customer.

Ticket 30218: On 12 June I collected the vehicle I had reserved two months in advance, only to be told the model was unavailable and I must pay an upgrade fee. This was most inconvenient and I do not believe I should bear the cost.

I have been a loyal customer for eleven years and would appreciate a written response regarding the $45 difference charged.

I am writing to report that my account appears to have been accessed by someone else, as it shows ticket purchases I did not make. I have changed my password and submitted a report through the app. I would appreciate a thorough review of the security of this platform. The situation is concerning, though I trust it will be resolved.

Okay so I've been chatting with your support since 9am this morning — that's the THIRD session today. Yesterday an agent told me my refunded lab fee of $267.40 would 'post within 24 hours,' which was five days ago. I'm a working student, I rely on financial aid disbursements, and your system STILL shows the charge as active while my bank shows nothing coming back.

Meanwhile your last agent 'Marcus' closed my chat mid-conversation and apparently my transcript 'cannot be retrieved.' So here I am starting over AGAIN, explaining the same billing error to a fourth person, with my rent due Friday and $267 of my money in limbo because your billing system can't process a refund it approved a week ago. This is beyond a joke.

So after three years of loyal service, including the move where I carried my own grandmother's china down the stairs because your crew refused to touch it, your dispatchers had the absolute gall to leave my entire household of furniture sitting on a stranger's curb in the rain in Dayton while I spent four hours on hold listening to that awful kazoo music only to be told, and I quote, the truck has been reassigned, which by the way I found out from the NEW tenants of my old house calling to say my stuff was blocking their driveway, so congratulations, you have single-handedly ruined my kids' first week at a new school and I will be telling every single person I meet about this until the day I die.

third week without my account and your 'escalation team' has done absolutely nothing except send me the same copy-paste garbage, i am done with this joke of a helpdesk, fix it today or i'm going straight to the dean and the student paper
My account got locked after the password reset yesterday. Reset emails aren't arriving, checked spam. Been locked out for a day now. Can someone just unlock it or send a working link?
Hello — I was charged $47.50 on my student account on March 14th (order #IT-SRV-88214) for a software license I never activated, so I'd like to request a refund when someone has a moment, thanks.
Third outage this month. Payments taken, service down. Support radio silence. @toolname absolute joke of a company. Unbelievable.

hi there so our team switched over to your tool last month and mostly its been going ok but my dashboard widgets keep forgetting the filters i set on them so every morning i have to redo them which is a bit of a pain. also not sure if this is related but the mobile app takes forever to sync sometimes. no big rush on this just wondering if theres a fix coming or if im doing something wrong. thanks

Overall the app is good and I use it every day for my shop accounts. Since the last update the app is sometimes slow when I open the reports and one time it did not save my note on an invoice, but it came back later so maybe it was my phone. The support answered my question in two days, which was okay. I would give four stars if the reports open faster.

Hey team, a couple of questions from a longtime player:

- Will the double XP event from last weekend be compensated for players who lost connection mid-session?
- Is there an estimated date for the console hotfix mentioned in the roadmap?
- Any chance the holiday cosmetics from 2022 return to the shop?

No rush, just curious. Thanks for a great year of content!

Good afternoon. I write to inquire about my internet service, which has been disconnected since Saturday the 14th despite my payment of the monthly invoice on the 10th. I would be most obliged if someone could restore the connection or advise when I might expect it to be working again. Thank you kindly for your attention.

Caller asked, with dry amusement, whether the 'scheduled maintenance' that has apparently run every Sunday for two months was a genuine system update or just a standing excuse, and wanted to know when reports would be accessible on weekends.
caller says the app wont let him add a new card and asks if theres a known issue, no frustration expressed

Report export is stuck at 40%. Tried twice, same result.

Please advise.
Third week my invoices sit in 'pending sync' while payroll deadline passes tomorrow — is anyone from support actually reading these threads?

I am writing for the third time regarding invoice #8842, which charged me $1,150 in duplicate fuel surcharges despite two written confirmations that the error would be corrected, and I have yet to receive either a refund or a substantive response.

I'm writing regarding my move last Thursday — I want to flag something that genuinely concerns me: several boxes were loaded onto the wrong truck, and one of them contains important documents I need for work this week. The crew left around 6pm and the paperwork was never signed off properly either. To summarize my concerns:

• Boxes #4, #7, and #9 went to the wrong destination
• Missing signature on the inventory sheet
• No callback despite two voicemails left on Friday

I'd appreciate a quick resolution when someone gets a chance. It's not a huge deal yet, but it is becoming an inconvenience.

Oh, wonderful. I ordered a coat in November and it's now February, so I guess it's my new annual tradition to watch your 'In Transit' status age like fine wine. And when I asked for a refund, your bot helpfully offered me a 10% coupon. For what, exactly? Air?

Please do me a favor and don't reply with 'We apologize for any inconvenience.' I've been inconvenienced enough to qualify for a formal apology tour. Just return my $189 and never contact me again.

Oh sure, why would the rental car you gave me come with a flat tire AND a check engine light? What a delightful bonus package. Don't worry about the inspection report I sent yesterday, I'm sure you're all very busy ignoring those too.

Ah yes, another 'scheduled maintenance window' that started Friday at 6pm and, shockingly, is still ongoing Monday morning. The wifi in the engineering building has now been down longer than the maintenance was supposed to last (4 hours, per the email), but I guess the status page updating to say 'we are aware of the issue' counts as progress. Maybe next time the notice could include an actual estimated completion time instead of the word 'soon.'

hey so my app keeps saying my booking under case #7719 is cancelled but i never cancelled anything and the confirmation email is still there. kinda annoying since im supposed to pick the car up tomorrow morning. can someone check whats going on pls

I must inform you, for the third time this month, that my online account remains locked despite following the password reset instructions your previous agents sent me, and I would be most grateful if a competent representative could finally resolve this matter before my scheduled rental on Friday.

Hi, I see my VM is showing as terminated and all the data maybe is gone? It was running the database for my online store. I am not angry, just worry, can you check please what happened and if restore is possible?

Caller stated that reservation 44910-C for pickup on 22 May at 9:00 AM was missing from the system and that a $58.40 hold from 15 May remains on his card; he remained courteous and simply asked how the charge would be resolved.

Caller states order placed eleven days ago. Package shows returned to warehouse. Nobody notified him. He has now missed four days of his seizure medication and spent the weekend in the emergency room after a breakthrough seizure. He wants to know who is paying for that. Second call today. First representative promised a transfer to a supervisor that never happened. Caller disconnected after forty minutes on hold and states he is filing complaints with the board of pharmacy and his insurance, and wants the account closed today.

Hello, I'm writing about a small issue with my recent trip. Here are the details: • Ride on Tuesday, April 9, around 6:15 PM from Elm Street to Central Station • Fare charged twice on my card ending 4417 • Total: $18.60 duplicated. Could someone look into refunding the extra charge when convenient? Thanks very much for your help. Best regards, Daniel Okafor

• App logged me out mid-checkout and then charged my card without creating an order • support bot looped me back to the same FAQ four times • food never came • still charged, still shrugging, one star
Hi, my delivery was rescheduled for the second time and I've already taken a day off work, so please confirm the new date. Thanks.

Hello, my move order #SL-20914 was scheduled for April 3 and the crew of four arrived but the system still shows it as 'pending dispatch,' and I also notice a $625 charge on my Visa ending 4471 dated April 1 that I'd like clarified, though I understand these systems sometimes lag — could someone please confirm? Thanks.
SCAM ALERT. @exchange froze my account with $11k in it. Zero notice. Zero reply in 9 DAYS. Moving every cent the second I get access. Absolute clowns.

Just a heads up that the invoice numbering has restarted from 001 since your last patch, which I only noticed after sending out a batch of duplicates to clients. I've been with you since the QuickBooks migration in 2021 and this is the first real headache, but I'd appreciate a fix and maybe a note in the release notes next time so I don't have to apologise to customers on your behalf.

I would like to politely inform the developers that I have been charged three times this month for a subscription I cannot even access, because the app has crashed on the loading screen every single day for two weeks. I have submitted four support requests and received nothing but automated replies. This is unacceptable, and I will be disputing the charges and cancelling unless this is fixed immediately.

Driver screamed at my mother for 'taking too long' to get in the car. She's 71 and uses a walker. Support's response: 'we've noted your feedback.' Unbelievable. Nobody fired, nobody called, nothing. Last ride with this company.
so app has been down since 6pm, cant log in, cant even see my past orders. support chat is a bot loop that does nothing. this is the last straw honestly, moving all my orders to a competitor tonight

Caller had three points: one, the app logged her out on both devices and won't accept her password reset emails (she checked spam). Two, she has $22 in account credit she can't access as a result. Three, she made the call during her lunch break and would like it sorted today rather than waiting another 48 hours for a reply, as the last one arrived after the problem had already cost her two dinner orders.

Absolutely the worst experience of my life, and I do not say that lightly. Consider what your 'professional' crew did: • Dropped my 65-inch TV down a flight of stairs and called it a 'manufacturing defect' • Loaded my grandmother's antique hutch without wrapping it, leaving a gash down the side • Smoked in the cab with my boxes inside, so everything arrived smelling like an ashtray • Charged my card twice and then had the gall to send me a 'thanks for choosing us' email • Refused to unload until I paid a 'long carry fee' that was never in my quote. I have filed complaints with the DOT, the BBB, and my credit card company, and I will spend every spare minute of my life making sure no one I know ever hires these criminals.

Reached out to support about my account being locked after the password reset last Tuesday. Still waiting on a reply, and the automated line keeps repeating the same menu options. My six-week progress is just sitting there untouched. Hoping the team sees this — a nudge would help. Otherwise the app itself has been great.

Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding the automatic renewal charge of $89.99 applied to my account on the 3rd, as I had understood from our previous correspondence that my subscription was cancelled in October. I would be grateful if you could review this matter and process a refund at your earliest convenience, as I do not believe I should be paying for a service I explicitly declined. I have been a customer since 2015 and would prefer to resolve this politely without further inconvenience to either party. Yours faithfully, Margaret E. Holloway
Hey, quick question. I ordered from the Thai place on Elm St last week and got charged a small service fee I don't remember seeing before. Not a big deal, just wondering what changed? Thx

So let me tell you a story about @UniITHelp. Two weeks before my thesis defense, my university email account gets suspended because, and I quote, 'automated security review.' I've been at this school seven years. Seven years of paying that tech fee on every single tuition bill. I lost access to my advisor's emails, my committee drafts, my defense schedule — everything — during the most important week of my degree.

I called the helpdesk Monday, got told to 'submit a web form.' Submitted it. Called Tuesday, sat on hold for 90 minutes, got hung up on. Called Wednesday, the person who answered said the suspension ticket 'doesn't exist.' An IT security review that doesn't exist, suspending an account that has my entire academic life in it, with a defense in SIX DAYS. If this isn't fixed by Friday I'm showing up to the IT building in person and I'm bringing my thesis committee's phone numbers with me.

I am writing about ticket #77419, which I opened on April 2 regarding a duplicate charge of $49.99 on my monthly trading fee subscription. My bank statement from April 1 shows two identical charges from your merchant account, and my invoice dashboard only reflects one payment. I have attached both statements for reference.

I'd appreciate it if this could be resolved before my next billing cycle on May 1, as I would prefer not to dispute the charge with my bank. Please confirm once the refund has been processed.
Please reset the billing address on my housing internet invoice to the corrected address below and confirm once processed — thank you.

Oh FANTASTIC, my driver cancelled on me for the THIRD time tonight. Love standing on a freezing curb at 1am while your app politely says 'finding a new driver.' Truly a premium experience.
And then your support line hangs up on me after 20 minutes on hold? Incredible. I've deleted my account and I want every ride fee from this month refunded. Do NOT reply with a generic apology bot message.

I have used this application for approximately two years, generally with satisfaction. However, I must express my disappointment with the recent interface update. The new layout places the destination field in a location I find unnecessarily difficult to reach, and I have on several occasions accidentally cancelled a ride while attempting to confirm it.

I would respectfully request that the developers consider restoring an option for the previous design, or at the very least provide a larger confirmation step before cancellations. I am sure I am not the only customer of a certain age who finds these constant changes rather trying.
